subject: Billing override request & VAT routing for Meditech connector spike
messages:
From: Oliver Kane <okane@meditech.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@meditech.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 17:14:00 +0100
Subject: Unexpected June spike — request for billing override and VAT handling

Hi Priya,

We noticed a large spike on our June invoice for the Meditech connector (Invoice #M-20270630). The usage looks like it was driven by a misrouted integration that retried ~6M extra tokens overnight. Our finance team is asking for a goodwill adjustment and confirmation on how VAT will be treated for the remediated amount — Meditech is EU-registered and expects reverse-charge handling.

Can Redwood provisionally apply an override or provisional credit while you investigate? If you need evidence we can provide the VAT registration certificate and a brief incident timeline. We also need the expected date the credit will post so our AP can reconcile.

Attaching a PDF export of the invoice for reference.

Thanks,
Oliver Kane
Head of Platform Ops
Meditech, Ltd.
attachments: meditech_invoice_jun2027.pdf

---
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Kane <okane@meditech.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Unexpected June spike — request for billing override and VAT handling

Hi Oliver — thanks for the note and the invoice PDF.

We're sorry to see the spike. I've looped in Markus (Finance) and Grace (Customer Ops) so we can coordinate the remediation and VAT routing. Initial plan:
- We will provisionally put a billing hold and create a provisional credit line while the infra team validates the root cause.
- Finance can propose a provisional credit amount for reconciliation; final posting will follow confirmation of the spike and VAT evidence.

Could you send over Meditech's EU VAT registration (if available) and a short timeline describing when the retries started/stopped? Once we have the VAT cert we can confirm whether the adjustment will be processed as a net credit with reverse-charge handling (no VAT applied by Redwood) or if any local tax steps are required for our accounting team.

Provisional timeline from our side: draft credit memo within 5 business days; final posting within 10 business days after VAT evidence and validation. I will follow up if we need anything else.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

---
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Oliver Kane <okane@meditech.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2027 11:35:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Unexpected June spike — request for billing override and VAT handling

Hi all — quick finance readout. We reviewed the invoice and sample logs provided by the team. Proposal:

- Apply a provisional service credit of EUR 11,200 (approx $12,450) to offset the June overage. This number represents the excess token charge after removing the retried requests and applying contracted discounts.
- Post the credit as a credit memo tied to Invoice #M-20270630.
- VAT treatment: because Meditech is EU-registered and has indicated they qualify for reverse-charge, Redwood will issue the credit memo net of VAT. Please attach the VAT registration (VIES) to the ticket; once verified we will annotate the credit memo with the reverse-charge reference.

Operational notes:
- We will draft the proposed credit memo and share a DocuSign link for your AP to acknowledge the adjustment (paper trail required for our auditors).
- Expected timing: draft credit memo 2 business days after VAT verification; posting to ledger 5 business days after DocuSign completion.

I've attached the proposed credit memo draft and a short checklist for AP to help reconciliation.

Attachments: proposed-credit-memo-draft.pdf

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Can you also confirm whether the posted credit will adjust our next invoice or if you'll issue a standalone credit note? Either is fine, but we need to show it against the June period for audit.

Quick answers:
- VAT certificate attached.
- AP prefers standalone credit memo so the book entries are obvious, but will accept offset on next invoice if that's standard for Redwood.

Please send the DocuSign link and provisional credit memo number when available.

Best,
